name: Generate This Week's Schedule
description: Manually trigger the weekly schedule and caption generator.

then.prompt: Generate this week's full posting schedule for MainStay TV starting from next Monday. Steps: 1) Scan Content-data/ and ensure all assets are in the database. 2) Query unposted assets for both GOLIDE and Delah Dube. 3) Build a 7-day schedule using the weekly template (Mon=Instagram Feed, Tue=TikTok, Wed=Instagram Story, Thu=TikTok, Fri=Instagram Reel + WhatsApp). 4) Generate platform-specific captions for each post using the caption formula. 5) Insert all posts and captions into the database. 6) Export the full schedule with captions to agent/schedules/week-<YYYY-WW>.md. 7) Print the full calendar preview.
